These ABC files are small complete tunes that `tests/test_fixtures.py` runs the parser, validator and repeat expansion over. `twinkle.abc` (a traditional, public-domain melody) and `standard_examples.abc` (repeat structures from the ABC standard 2.1 with made-up notes) were written for this test suite; `jacobs.abc` holds three tunes copied, header fields included, from David Jacobs' CC0 1.0 collection of 18th-century country-dance books at https://github.com/Gubbledenut/ABC_TuneBooks. All of them may be used freely.
